how.intro: {site} is {pixels, number} pixels in one place. Buy some of them once, put your picture on them, and it stays there for good — for as long as the site exists.
how.step1: Drag over the pixels to select a free area. It snaps to blocks of 10 × 10 px, and you see the size and the price right away. Not sure where? “Find me a spot” suggests free places of the size you want.
how.step2: Upload a photo — our pixel filter turns it into exactly as many pixels as you buy — draw in the pixel editor or write a text. Add a title, an optional link and your name or nickname.
how.step3Title: Pay and your pixels go live
how.step3: Pay securely by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay. A person checks every picture, usually within {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}, and then your pixels are published for good.
how.pricesIntro: One pixel costs {price}. You pay once; there is no yearly fee.
how.rules: Pictures, drawings and texts that follow our <rules>content rules</rules>: nothing illegal, no nudity, violence, hate or scams, and only content you have the rights to. All pixels form one still picture, so animations and videos are not possible.

faq.intro: Answers to the most common questions. Something else? <contact>Write to us</contact>.
faq.costA: {price} per pixel, paid once. The smallest spot is one block of 10 × 10 px for {block}; 50 × 50 px costs {spot50} and 100 × 100 px costs {spot100}. {vat}
faq.howLongQ: How long will my pixels stay published?
faq.howLongA: For good. You pay once and your picture stays published for as long as {site} exists. There is no yearly fee and nothing to renew.
faq.whatQ: What can I put on my pixels?
faq.whatA: A photo or a picture (PNG, JPG, WebP or a still GIF up to {mb} MB), a drawing from our pixel editor, or a coloured area with text. You can add a title, a link and your name or nickname. Everything has to follow the <rules>content rules</rules>.
faq.whenQ: When will my pixels be published?
faq.whenA: After a person checks your picture, usually within {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} of your payment. We let you know by e-mail as soon as it is published.
faq.rejectedQ: What if you reject my content?
faq.rejectedA: You get an e-mail with the reason and can send different content within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}; your spot stays reserved for you until then. If you do not, we refund the whole payment and the spot is free again.
faq.changeQ: Can I change my picture later?
faq.changeA: Yes, at any time in My pixels: the picture, the title, the link or the name. Every change is checked again, and until then your current picture stays published.
faq.closeQ: What happens if the website closes one day?
faq.closeA: We want to keep the site online for a very long time. If we ever had to close it, we would tell all owners by e-mail in advance. The details are in the <terms>terms of service</terms>.
faq.blocksQ: Why are pixels sold in blocks of 10 × 10?
faq.blocksA: A single pixel would be too small to see or to click. Blocks of 10 × 10 px keep the pixels tidy, make every spot clickable and easy to find. The smallest spot is one block, that is 100 pixels.
faq.giftQ: Can I give my pixels as a gift?
faq.giftA: Yes. In My pixels choose “Give this spot to someone else” and enter their e-mail address. They get a link and become the new owner once they accept it.
faq.receiptA: Yes. After the payment we send you the confirmation with a receipt by e-mail, and you can print every receipt or save it as PDF in My pixels.
faq.privateQ: Will my e-mail address be visible?
faq.privateA: No. Only the title, the link and the public name you choose are shown publicly. Your e-mail address stays private.

legal.terms:
## 1. Who we are
The website {site} (the “site”) is operated by {operator}, company ID {companyId}, registered office {address}, e-mail {email} (the “operator”, “we”). Registration: {todo}

## 2. What you buy
- The site shows {pixels, number} pixels divided into blocks of 10 × 10 px. You buy the right to show your own content (a picture, drawing or text with an optional link) on a rectangle of whole blocks that you choose (the “spot”).
- The price is {price} per pixel. You pay once; there are no recurring fees. All prices are final. {vat}
- Your content stays published without a time limit, for as long as we operate the site. You do not become the owner of any part of the site, its software or the picture of all pixels as a whole.

## 3. How the contract is made
- You choose a spot (we reserve it for you for a short time), add your content and details, agree to these terms and to the [content rules](/content-rules) and pay through the payment provider Stripe.
- The contract is made when your payment is received. We send you a confirmation with a receipt by e-mail.
- Before your content is published, a person checks it, usually within {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}.

## 4. Approval and rejection
- If we cannot approve your content, we tell you why. You can send different content within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}; the spot stays reserved for you until then.
- If no acceptable content arrives in time, the contract ends and we refund the whole payment automatically.

## 5. Your content
- You are responsible for your content. You confirm that you have all rights to it and that it follows the content rules and the law.
- You allow us to show your content on the site, in pictures of the pixels (for example in previews on social networks) and in materials about the site, for as long as the site exists.
- You can change your content at any time in My pixels; every change is checked again.
- If content breaks the content rules or the law, we can hide it at once and remove it. Content removed for breaking the rules is not refunded. We always tell you the reasons and you can object.

## 6. Giving the spot to someone else
You can give your spot to another person in My pixels. Your rights and obligations under these terms pass to the new owner when they accept the offer.

## 7. Right of withdrawal
- As a consumer you can withdraw from a contract made at a distance within 14 days without giving a reason.
- When ordering, you ask us to start the service before this period ends and you acknowledge that you lose the right of withdrawal once your content is published. Until then you can withdraw by e-mail to {email}; we refund the payment within 14 days.
- Model withdrawal form: {todo}

## 8. Availability and the end of the site
- We take care that the site works without interruption, but we cannot guarantee it at every moment (maintenance, outages of our providers).
- We intend to run the site for an indefinite time. If we ever decide to close it, we will tell all owners by e-mail in advance. Notice period and what owners receive in that case: {todo}

## 9. Complaints
How to make a complaint is described in the [complaints procedure](/complaints).

## 10. Personal data
We process personal data as described in the [privacy policy](/privacy).

## 11. Final provisions
- These terms are governed by the law of the Slovak Republic. Alternative dispute resolution for consumers: {todo}
- We may change these terms for the future; the terms in force on the day of your payment apply to your purchase.
- These terms are valid from {todo}.
legal.complaints:
This procedure explains how to complain if our service does not work as it should — for example if your spot is not shown correctly, your approved content is not shown or a payment was not processed properly.

## How to complain
- Write to {email} or use the [contact form](/contact) (topic “Complaint or legal matter”).
- Please give the spot number, the e-mail address of your order, what is wrong and, if possible, a screenshot.
- We confirm without delay that we received your complaint.

## How we handle a complaint
- We decide about your complaint without delay, at the latest within 30 days of receiving it, and tell you the result by e-mail.
- If the complaint is justified, we fix the problem (for example we show your content correctly again); if that is not possible, we refund the price or a fair part of it.
- We keep a record of every complaint and how it was resolved.

## Objections to moderation decisions
If you do not agree with a decision about your content (rejection, hiding or removal), reply to our e-mail or write to {email}. A person looks at the decision again.

## Alternative dispute resolution
If you are not satisfied with how we handled your complaint, you can ask us for a remedy. If we refuse it or do not answer within 30 days, you can turn to a body for the alternative resolution of consumer disputes: {todo}

This procedure is valid from {todo}.

## What data we process and why
- Orders and payments: your e-mail address, the spot, your content, title, link and public name, your consents and payment records — to conclude and perform the contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) and to meet accounting duties (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR). Card details are handled only by the payment provider Stripe; we never see them.
- Account (My pixels): your e-mail address and sign-in records — to let you manage your spots (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
- Moderation and reports: checks of content, reports and decisions, including the e-mail address of a reporter who gives one — to meet the duties of the Digital Services Act and for a safe site (Art. 6(1)(c) and (f) GDPR).
- Contact form: your name, e-mail address and message — to answer you (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
- Security: a one-way coded (hashed) form of your IP address to limit abuse, for example the number of reservations, and technical server logs (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
- News by e-mail: only if you agree; you can withdraw your consent at any time (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR).

## Public content
Your picture, title, link and public name are shown publicly on the site. Your e-mail address is never shown.

## Cookies
We use only cookies the site needs to work: your sign-in, an order in progress and the language you chose. We use no advertising or tracking cookies. Visits are counted without cookies and without identifying you. Statistics service: {todo}

## Who receives the data
Only providers who help us run the site, under data processing agreements: hosting and database {todo}, file storage {todo}, payments (Stripe), sending e-mails {todo}, protection against bots (Cloudflare Turnstile) and checks of links and pictures for dangerous content {todo}. Some of them are based outside the EU; the transfer is protected by the EU standard contractual clauses or the EU–US Data Privacy Framework.

## How long we keep data
- Orders and receipts: as long as accounting and tax law requires (in Slovakia generally 10 years).
- Account: until you delete it in My pixels.
- Messages from the contact form: two years after they are handled.
- Reports: {todo} after they are resolved.
- Technical logs and security records: a short time, at most {todo}.

## Your rights
You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and data portability, and the right to object; consent can be withdrawn at any time. Write to {email}. You can delete your account yourself in My pixels. You can also lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority: the Office for Personal Data Protection of the Slovak Republic, Hraničná 12, 820 07 Bratislava, www.dataprotection.gov.sk.
